{"metadata":{"description":"Multi-user login gateway plugin for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI: login wall, per-user conversation isolation, in-GUI user management","id":"gh:1336864972","install_available":true,"language":"TypeScript","name":"dsh-login","slug":"islibaodong/dsh-login","topics":["authentication","cordis-plugin","deepseek-harness","dsh","dsh-plugin","login","single-sign-on","typescript"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"Multi-user login gateway plugin for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI: login wall, per-user conversation "},{"id":"p1s2","text":"isolation, in-GUI user management"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-login"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"English | 简体中文"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"Adds a **login page, user accounts, and per-user conversation isolation** to the DeepSeek Harness We"},{"id":"p4s2","text":"b GUI: every visit requires sign-in, ordinary users cannot see each other's conversations, and an ad"},{"id":"p4s3","text":"min manages all accounts from inside the GUI."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"| Login page | User management (设置 → 用户管理) |
|:---:|:---:|"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"## The problem it solves"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"The DSH Web GUI ships with **no login** — it assumes a single user on localhost. The moment you bind"},{"id":"p7s2","text":" it to `0.0.0.0` (phone access, LAN sharing, a small team), **anyone on that network can open your G"},{"id":"p7s3","text":"UI**: read every conversation, burn your configured model API keys, even change host settings."},{"id":"p8s1","text":"`dsh-login` turns that exposure into a multi-user deployment:"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"- 🔐 **Login wall** — pages, static assets, SPA routes, the API, and WebSockets all require a valid s"},{"id":"p9s2","text":"ession; unauthenticated visitors are redirected to `/login`
- 👥 **Multiple accounts** — the first vi"},{"id":"p9s3","text":"sit creates the administrator account; further users are added by an admin right inside the GUI, no "},{"id":"p9s4","text":"CLI needed
- 🙈 **Conversation isolation** — ordinary users see and act on **their own** conversation"},{"id":"p9s5","text":"s only (including their subagents/forks); the bridge wall denies non-whitelisted methods and narrows"},{"id":"p9s6","text":" `session.list`/`session.search`/`workspace.list` responses to owned sessions, and the composed REMO"},{"id":"p9s7","text":"TE-layer guard scopes dispatches by ownership; other users' sessions, messages, and workspaces are i"},{"id":"p9s8","text":"nvisible; credentials, host settings, and other admin domains are forbidden wholesale
- 🛠 **User man"},{"id":"p9s9","text":"agement** — 设置 → 用户管理: last-login time, online session count, reset password, disable, remove; disab"},{"id":"p9s10","text":"ling/removing/password-changes **immediately revoke** that user's live sessions
- 👑 **Admin exceptio"},{"id":"p9s11","text":"n** — the admin is not isolated: all sessions visible, full configuration access
- 🚪 **Logout** — ev"},{"id":"p9s12","text":"ery user gets a logout entry in their settings panel
- 🌐 **Remote access friendly** — reach the GUI "},{"id":"p9s13","text":"through frp/隧道/tunnels or a LAN IP without hand-editing `trustedHosts`: the `/api` host-trust fence "},{"id":"p9s14","text":"uses a live set (LAN literals + `trustedHosts` + auto-learned hosts), and any successful login learn"},{"id":"p9s15","text":"s its Host into a persisted whitelist you can manage in 设置 → 用户管理"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"## Current status — released (option A)"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"> **Released: `@islibaodong/dsh-login@0.3.12` (git tag `v0.3.12`; published on npm — `latest` = 0.3."},{"id":"p11s2","text":"12).** Security release — verified against DSH **0.2.2-rc.1** (dependency line unchanged; full suite"},{"id":"p11s3","text":" **22 files / 291 tests** green, CI green). **0.3.12 ships the streaming-method isolation fix (issue"},{"id":"p11s4","text":" #11)**: the `/api` bridge wall only intercepted POSTs, so streaming methods (`workspace.follow` tre"},{"id":"p11s5","text":"es, and id-carrying invokes such as `session.page`/`session.follow`) traveled the `/api/remote.mux` "},{"id":"p11s6","text":"WebSocket past every filter — ordinary users could enumerate and switch into other users' workspaces"},{"id":"p11s7","text":". The new **dispatch-seam guard** tags each browser peer with its dsh-login identity at connection a"},{"id":"p11s8","text":"dmission (enforcing the login session on the WebSocket upgrade too), then gates `dispatchRpc`/`openW"},{"id":"p11s9","text":"ireStream` per user: non-user methods are denied, every id argument is ownership-checked, and `works"},{"id":"p11s10","text":"pace.follow` frames are filtered per frame (mirroring upstream's per-principal follow semantics — na"},{"id":"p11s11","text":"rrowed baselines, delivered-set accounting with replace-resync on visibility loss, fail-closed on un"},{"id":"p11s12","text":"known frames). `workspace.create` and the provisioner now record workspace ownership. Untagged peers"},{"id":"p11s13","text":"rkspace.create` and the provisioner now record workspace ownership. Untagged peers [长行截断]
>
[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"## Quick start"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"No environment variables, no config edits — three steps:"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"2. **Initialize**: restart `dsh web` and open the GUI — the first visit shows a one-time "create adm"},{"id":"p15s2","text":"inistrator account" page; pick a username and password
3. **Add users**: sign in as admin → 设置 → 用户管"},{"id":"p15s3","text":"or account" page; pick a username and password
3. **Add users**: sign in as admin → 设置 → 用户管理 → 新建用户"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"Uninstall:"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"## What installation does"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"`dsh plugin add` reads this package's declared `cordis.patch.yml` (a bundle patch) and automatically"},{"id":"p20s2","text":"dsh plugin add` reads this package's declared `cordis.patch.yml` (a bundle patch) and automatically:"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"- mounts the `dsh-login` plugin row (config defaults are sensible; `distIndex` resolves the frontend"},{"id":"p21s2","text":" dist automatically)
- disables the `web-runtime` row (where dsh-web-app mounts the frontend-static "},{"id":"p21s3","text":"fallback); dsh-login takes over the fallback seat and re-provides the `webRuntime` service (LAN trus"},{"id":"p21s4","text":"t for the `/api` fence + the `DSH_WEB_URL` variable)
- **keeps the shipped `connection` row enabled*"},{"id":"p21s5","text":"* (option A, DSH ≥ 0.1.5): dsh-client-connection owns the `/api` carrier and browser-session auth; d"},{"id":"p21s6","text":"sh-login composes its login wall (fallback seat) + per-user isolation primitive on top. It ships its"},{"id":"p21s7","text":" own browser bundle `dist/client.js` for the settings panel only."},{"id":"p22s1","text":"## How it works"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"- **Cookie:** `dsh_session`, HttpOnly, SameSite=Strict, Path=/
- **Session:** 32-byte random token ("},{"id":"p24s2","text":"256-bit) with TTL expiry; sessions carry the username and admin flag and are persisted across restar"},{"id":"p24s3","text":"ts (<dataDir>/sessions.json, 0o600), so an in-flight SPA keeps working after a process reload instea"},{"id":"p24s4","text":"d of turning every /api call into a 401
- **Password storage:** scrypt hashes (per-user salt) in the"},{"id":"p24s5","text":" DSH credentials system under `${password}_USERS`"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"## Security notes"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"## Architecture note: fallback vs prefix /"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"The gateway uses `registerFallback()` (not `register({ kind: 'prefix', path: '/' })`) because the DS"},{"id":"p27s2","text":"H WebServer's prefix matching checks `pathname.startsWith(prefix + '/')`. For prefix `/`, this becom"},{"id":"p27s3","text":"es `//`, which no normal path starts with -- a `prefix /` route only matches the exact path `/`. The"},{"id":"p27s4","text":" fallback handler catches everything no named route claims, which is the correct catch-all behavior "},{"id":"p27s5","text":"for the authentication gateway."},{"id":"p28s1","text":"The WebServer has a single fallback seat. dsh-web-app's `web-runtime` row mounts frontend-static ove"},{"id":"p28s2","text":"r it unconditionally, so the `web-runtime` row must be disabled when using `dsh-login`; dsh-login re"},{"id":"p28s3","text":"-provides the `webRuntime` service that row owned (LAN trust, `DSH_WEB_URL`), leaving the rest of th"},{"id":"p28s4","text":"e composition intact."}],"truncated":true}
